alternative_interpretations: The scene may depict staged performance or satire, given the unnatural positioning and speech bubble—a common convention in edited or illustrative imagery rather than documentary photography.
limitations: The speech bubble is superimposed and not part of the original photographic record; its content cannot be verified as spoken or intended by the subjects.

limitations: No official logos or country names are legible; flag motifs are generic and could represent multiple nations or be stylized abstractions.
